name: Cash Forecast Agent
fn: Predicts payment arrival timing from customer behaviour and invoice patterns
detail: Predicts when each customer will pay using time-series models over invoice attributes and historical behaviour, feeding a daily cash-arrival forecast to treasury. Replaces spreadsheet guesswork with a data-driven forecast.
sap: SAP FI-AR (open items, F-28 / F-32 clearing) · FI-BL bank statements (FF67, BAI2 / MT940) · BAPI_ACC_DOCUMENT_POST

io.in: Remittances · bank files (BAI2/MT940) · FI-AR open items
